name: JR-EAST Train Reservation (East Japan Shinkansen and limited express)
intro: JR East's booking site covers the Shinkansen lines heading north and northwest from Tokyo (Tohoku, Hokkaido, Hokuriku and Joetsu), the Narita Express and limited express trains. Reserved seats open one month ahead and can sell out at holiday peaks.

facts.location: Tokyo to Tohoku, Hokkaido, Hokuriku and Niigata
facts.bookAhead: One month: seats open at 10:00 on the same date a month before

statusNote: Read from JR Hokkaido's official English page, which uses the same JR-EAST Train Reservation system. The eki-net.com page itself could not be read automatically.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: many visitors use JR East trains, but few need to book the moment seats open.
difficultyNote: Reasoning: seats are usually available, except on popular trains at holiday peaks (New Year, Golden Week, Obon).
bookingSteps: Go to JR-EAST Train Reservation, JR East's English booking site.
Using a JR East rail pass? Buy it on the same site first. Seats for the nationwide Japan Rail Pass are not reserved here.
From 10:00 Japan time, one month before your travel date, choose your train and seat. You can book until 6 minutes before departure.
Pay by credit card. If your card is declined, try another card or buy at a station.
Before boarding, collect your tickets from a reserved-seat ticket machine at a JR East station, using the card you paid with. Allow extra time, as stations can be crowded.
visitorTips: You also need a basic fare ticket. In IC card areas, an IC card can cover the fare.
If the same date doesn't exist in the previous month (for example March 31), sales start on the 1st of the travel month.
Busy times sell out fast: New Year, Golden Week (late April to early May) and Obon (mid-August).

faq.q: When can I book JR East trains like the Tohoku Shinkansen?
faq.a: From 10:00 Japan time one month before your travel date, on the JR-EAST Train Reservation site.

faq.q: Does this cover the Tokyo to Osaka Shinkansen?
faq.a: No. Tokyo to Osaka (the Tokaido Shinkansen) is run by JR Central and booked on SmartEX or JR-WEST Online. The release time is the same.

sources.quote: Reservation available from 10 am (JST) one month before the boarding date until 6 minutes before departure time
